checks_run.procedure: Judge adversarially whether EMPTY_EMIT can miss a syntax error the old path caught, in three steps. (a) Read TypeScript 6.0.2's transpileWorker and emitFiles. (b) Write my own differential probe that compares the pre-repair full transpile (the bbd6294 options and formatting) with the candidate's exported syntaxErrors, on a hostile corpus of 57 sources × 9 extensions and on all 448 real module files × 32 mutations × 3 extensions; run it on Node 24 and Node 22. (c) Mutate the testkit four ways, run architecture.test.ts against each, and restore the testkit byte for byte.
checks_run.command: see 06-empty-emit-source-analysis.log; cp repro/zz-sec-r4-rule4-differential.test.ts apps/api/src/ && npx vitest run --project unit-node --reporter=verbose <probe> [-t 'hostile corpus']; rm <probe>; mutants M1-M4 via python edit of architecture.testkit.ts, npx vitest run --project unit-node apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts, then cp back and git show HEAD:<file> | cmp
checks_run.expected: no diagnostic produced after the emit for a non-declaration transpile; 0 differences; every mutant caught; testkit restored
checks_run.actual: (a) transpileWorker adds getSyntacticDiagnostics and getOptionsDiagnostics before program.emit. All 17 context.addDiagnostic calls are inside transformDeclarations, and emitFiles adds only the declaration transform's diagnostics, so a JS emit contributes none. (b) Hostile corpus: 513 cases, 218 with errors, 0 differences, on both Nodes. The corpus covers decorators, using, import defer/source, attributes and assertions, JSX namespaces and mismatched tags, conflict markers, shebang placement, BOM and U+2028, numeric separators, octal escapes, invalid regexes, unterminated templates and comments, export= with ESM, accessor and const type parameters. Module mutants: 448 files, 44,352 cases, 28,801 with errors, 0 differences, on both Nodes. Probe run 1 exited 1 for two reasons, both in the probe and not the product. Its non-vacuity threshold was miscalibrated (218 is not > 228), and the 739 s synchronous loop starved vitest's RPC ('Timeout calling onTaskUpdate'). The 0-difference assertions passed in run 1. Run 2, with the threshold corrected to > 171 and the hostile part only, exits 0 on both Nodes. (c) Each mutant exits 1, by design: the run is expected to fail. M1 (reportDiagnostics removed): P20 and the guard fail. M2 (first diagnostic only): only the new guard fails, so the guard adds real detection. M3 (rule 4 disconnected): four planted controls fail (P20 and the F-DG1-137/217/218 declaration-file controls). M4 (TS-kind parse): the guard and the full walk fail. The testkit was restored and is identical to git HEAD. 06's first command block printed a bash 'syntax error in expression' because my grep for 'function emitFiles' matched three lines; the block was re-run with a fixed offset and appended. Residual, not a finding: a TypeScript printer crash on syntactically valid source used to throw and no longer does. That is not a syntax diagnostic, and rule 4 never reported one. D-175 observation (o), the surviving target-ES2015 mutant, is accepted as equivalent.
